name: Rozbrat 20

menus.name: Full tasting menu
menus.note: Also as a seasonal tasting menu at the same price (seasonal pairing PLN 650); pairings PLN 450 essential, PLN 450 alcohol-free or PLN 900 prestige; wagyu main PLN 150 extra

menus.name: Short tasting menu
menus.note: Two fewer courses than the full menu; also as a seasonal menu at the same price (seasonal pairing PLN 550); pairings PLN 350 essential, PLN 350 alcohol-free or PLN 800 prestige

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, which asks for a credit card to hold the booking. The phone is answered from 12pm to 4pm, Tuesday to Saturday; otherwise email biuro@rozbrat20.com.pl. Guests with vouchers book online.
cancellation: Cancel at least 24 hours ahead. Later cancellations and no-shows are charged PLN 500 a person to the card on file. Tables are held for 15 minutes; call if running late.
dressCode: Smart casual. No shorts or sportswear.
children: Guests aged 12 and over only. No children's menu or high chairs.
duration: About three hours for two to four guests; SevenRooms allows four and a half hours for larger tables.
